note: Claims register for public learning-feature copy (LX-30, UX-GLOBAL-07). Every bullet on the /pricing cohort card and every /landing feature card renders from one row here, so an unregistered bullet cannot ship. Each row names the code that does the work and a test that checks it. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from src/lib/content-truth.ts by src/lib/learning-claims.ts. Text is Sie or neutral (pick-copy-register B).

text.en: Over 10,000 questions · Kenntnisprüfung + Stichprobentest + Pharma bundled
